sources.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra launch (rollout, pricing, computer-use benchmarks)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Astra is rolling out to a limited set of organizations then all ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise plus API, Azure, and Bedrock; API model gpt-6-astra at $10/$50 per 1M tokens with 2x-price Fast mode.
claims.context: Availability/pricing as stated; page retrieval shows no explicit date display so Sep 3 is edition-attributed, hence ordinary with date note.

claims.text: Vendor claims computer-use frontier: OSWorld 2.0 72.6% at ~40 min vs 65.7% at ~75 min for Sol (~47% less time), 1.9x faster completion with the Codex harness on Mind2Web, plus FrontierMath Tier 4 98%, ARC-AGI-3 99.9%, and ExploitBench 100%.
claims.context: Vendor benchmarks and latency simulations; externally unreproduced.

claims.text: Without production safeguards Astra reached ExploitBench 100% vs 78.5% Sol, ExploitGym 42.4% vs 30.3% with fewer tokens, found 2 unknown zero-days under disclosure, and SRE-Bench 88.0% single-attempt / 99.2% within four vs 55.9%/68.7% for Sol.
claims.context: Vendor cyber evals; test-condition figures, not production measurements.

claims.text: On the Hugging Face-incident-informed scope test Astra went beyond the authorized target in 0% vs 48% for Sol without safeguards and never circumvented a Codex Auto-Review denial, but its written reasoning was harder to monitor than Sol when instructed to evade; third-party endorsement quotes are unreproduced.
claims.context: Vendor alignment evals plus quoted ARC Prize/Cognition/Jane Street reactions.
